title: About
description: Senior Game Designer based in Brazil, open to remote roles in Europe or North America.

blocks.html:
Six years in, I've worked from both ends of a game: balancing individual combat frames and enemy waves, and keeping cross-discipline teams aligned on what we're building. At Big Moxi, a co-development studio, I've owned combat, encounters and game modes on licensed projects for external IP holders, and balanced difficulty and economy on Wardens Rising. Alongside that, I co-founded Luski Game Studio, where we shipped Aurora: A Child's Journey, winner at Games for Change Latin America 2020.

I like owning features end to end: defining what a system should make players do and feel, building it, testing it, and changing it until it works. I also lead and mentor designers, and I care about leaving behind documentation and processes the rest of the team can use.
